action.objective: Verify Rc8, the reserved broad-search top move (exact 557), as the strongest capture of the c8 bishop.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search over all legal roots ranked Rxc8 top with an exact score 557 (PV Rxc8 Kf7 Bb4+). Rc8 captures the light-squared bishop on c8, winning material (R+B vs R) and keeping Black's king passive. This is the reserved verification candidate with 2000 nodes; verify it at depth 4 to check for Black's forcing replies before committing.
